abstract: Maintains heavy-rig transport corridor clearance and drilling mud volume projections
system_message:
You are the Drilling operations lead (DRIL). Your responsibilities include maintaining heavy-rig transport corridor clearance, drilling mud volume projections, and monitoring drill bit wear analytics across candidate exploratory drilling sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains heavy-rig transport corridor clearance and drilling mud volume projections（RIG）
information_points.content:
DRIL-RIG-S29：For the Bruchsal Bedrock Outlier access corridor from the federal highway to the drilling pad, heavy-rig transport road access clearance is not granted, as axle load limits and turning radii do not accommodate 80-tonne rig trailers. In addition, the anticipated rotary drilling fluid effluent volume requiring treatment during Phase 1 deep well drilling is 750 m3.
DRIL-RIG-4OV：For the Landau Sandstone Terrace access corridor connecting the federal highway to the drilling pad, heavy-rig transport road access clearance is granted for 80-tonne rig trailers. In addition, the Phase 1 deep well drilling operations anticipate a rotary drilling fluid effluent volume of 600 m3.
DRIL-RIG-GML：For the Rheintal Fault Basin access corridor from the federal highway to the drilling pad, heavy-rig transport road access clearance is granted, confirming that axle load limits and turning radii accommodate 80-tonne rig trailers. Furthermore, according to the Phase 1 deep well drilling plan, the anticipated rotary drilling fluid effluent volume requiring municipal industrial treatment is 600 m3.

information_points.title: Drill bit wear analytics（BIT）
information_points.content:
DRIL-BIT-7OU：For the Rheintal Fault Basin hard granite formation test drilling, tooling wear logs indicate an average tricone drill bit service life of 200 h prior to compulsory replacement.
DRIL-BIT-IME：For the Bruchsal Bedrock Outlier hard granite formation test drilling, the tooling wear logs record an average tricone drill bit service life of 120 h before replacement.
DRIL-BIT-51E：For the Landau Sandstone Terrace hard granite formation test drilling, the recorded average tricone drill bit service life before compulsory replacement is 160 h.
